T: Second star to the right. Snacks straight on.
D: A boy who never grows up takes Wendy and her brothers to Neverland to face Captain Hook.
P: Serve the snacks when the children fly over London.
S: the crocodile that swallowed a clock
Baguette slices toasted with olive oil, topped with smashed peas, mint and feta, the green ridges made with a fork.
Choux pastry with gruyère and pepper piped into small balls, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow.
Prawns poached in salted water with lemon, chilled and served on ice with a cocktail sauce of mayo, tomato sauce and lemon.
M: Captain Hook's ship in the bay
Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with dark rum, onion, carrots and allspice until thick, served with crusty bread.
the Lost Boys' hideout under the tree
Chicken drumsticks rubbed with honey, paprika and garlic, roasted at 200C for 40 minutes, with corn on the cob and roast potatoes to eat with your hands.
W: Tinker Bell and her pixie dust
White bread spread with butter and covered in hundreds and thousands, cut into triangles, dusted with a little edible glitter.
K: Nana the dog looking after the nursery
Milk warmed with honey, vanilla and a pinch of nutmeg, served in mugs at bedtime.

s.note: the crocodile that swallowed a clock
s.how: Slice a baguette and brush with olive oil, then toast until golden. Cook 300g peas, then smash with chopped mint, crumbled feta and a squeeze of lemon. Spread thickly on the toasts and run a fork along the top to make green crocodile ridges.

Bring a pot of salted water to the boil with lemon slices. Add 500g green prawns and poach for 2 minutes until pink, then plunge into iced water. Peel, leaving tails on, and serve on ice with a sauce of mayonnaise, tomato sauce, lemon and hot sauce.

m.note: Captain Hook's ship in the bay
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 carrots, add the beef back with 125ml dark rum, a teaspoon of allspice and water to cover. Simmer gently for 3 hours until thick and tender. Serve in big bowls with crusty bread.

w.note: Tinker Bell and her pixie dust
w.how: Spread slices of soft white bread with butter right to the edges. Press each buttered side into a plate of hundreds and thousands until well covered. Cut into triangles, dust with a tiny pinch of edible glitter and pile them on a plate.

d.note: Nana the dog looking after the nursery
d.how: Heat 1L milk gently until steaming but not boiling. Stir in 2 tbsp honey and a drop of vanilla until dissolved. Pour into mugs and grate a small pinch of nutmeg over the top. Serve at bedtime with the lights turned down low.
